content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Task Force Members
content.purpose: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development of these guidelines up to and including 2020).

summary_relationships.description: Employer (Glasgow University) paid by Amgen for time spent as Steering Committee member for the mecarbil (COSMIC-HF and GALACTIC-HF trial steering committees). Payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

Employer paid by AstraZeneca for time as Principal Investigator/Co-principal Investigator of DAPA-HF, DELIVER and DETERMINE trials (trials using dapagliflozin) and for related meetings; travel/accommodation paid; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

Employer paid by Bayer for time as Steering Committee member for the PANACHE trial using neladenoson bialanate and for the FINEARTS trial with finerenone; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

Employer paid by BMS for time as a Steering Committee member for the STAND-UP clinical trial (using a HNO donor) in heart failure and meetings related to this trial; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.
Employer paid by Boehringer-Ingelheim for advice about development of empagliflozin as a potential therapy for heart failure.
Employer paid by Cardurion for participation in a company advisory board about development of a PDE 9 inhibitor in heart failure.
Employer paid by Cyclerion for advice about development of praliciguat as a potential therapy for heart failure.

Employer paid by Cytokinetics for time as Steering Committee member for the ATOMIC-HF, COSMIC-HF and GALACTIC-HF trials and related meetings; travel/accommodation paid for some meetings/activities; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

Employer paid by DalCor for time as Steering Committee member for the Dal-GenE trial and related activities; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

Employer paid by GSK for time as Co-principal investigator and Steering Committee member for the Harmony-Outcomes trial (albiglutide) and ASCEND trials using daprodustat, and related meetings; travel/accommodation paid for some meetings; payments made through a consultancy with Glasgow University; no personal payments received.

genes.context: Mention of 'development of a PDE 9 inhibitor in heart failure' in relation to Cardurion advisory board activity.
